_comment: WHY: measured 2026-09-04 over 60 logged games, the combo funnel is two near-independent gates:
53% of games get an outlet + Peregrine Drake onto the battlefield, 55% get a SINK, and only 33%
get both. The engine is not at fault -- 84% of boards holding engine+sink went off, and of the
13 that assembled and did not, nine had no sink at all, so declining to loop was correct.
The sink gate is a DECKBUILDING fact: the whole 60-card universe holds three sinks, and one of
them (Shivan Gorge) is LEGENDARY, taps only for {C}, and costs {2}{R} to fire in a deck with no
red source. The other two are singleton SIDEBOARD creatures reachable only off 4 Living Wishes.
So: does maindecking the drain raise the go-off rate enough to pay for what it cuts? Cloud of
Faeries is the cut candidate because it untaps only TWO lands against a 3-mana blink, so it is
a marginal engine (it needs an aura'd land to be net-positive at all) where the Drake never is.
